record_text:
Key points.
Fixing household leaks. A dripping faucet can waste thousands of gallons a year; most leaks are cheap to fix.

In depth.
Check: read the meter, wait two hours without using water, read again. Fix: replace worn washers, flappers, and seals — usually a few dollars in parts. A running toilet alone can waste hundreds of gallons daily.
source_note: Sourced: standard hydrology and water-engineering knowledge.
